_comment: Prefixes an identifier may be written with or without (read by
app/fts_index.py, unprefixed_forms). A materials table under a 'UNS' column
prints 'N06625'; a question asks about 'UNS N06625'. Both must match.
The prefix is dropped ONLY when what remains is a code with a letter AND
a digit (N06625, A216, MR0175), so 'API 610' never becomes a bare '610'.
Matched case-insensitively. Edit this file to add a prefix; no code
change is needed. Call fts_index.reload_prefixes() in a running process.
